'''Jillie Lewin''' is a resident of [[Emond's Field]].

== Appearance ==
She has dark hair, which is braided.{{ref/book|Ravens}}

== Activities ==
A seventeen-year-old Jillie helps fold fleece when Egwene first carries water for the annual shearing.{{ref/book|1|Ravens}}
